changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to consistent capitalization and removed duplicates. Improved output description for clarity.
Consolidated PRP variants to the standard abbreviation. DICE and PRP are the only automatic metrics used.
No LLMs were used as judges in this paper (published in 2020, before widespread LLM-as-judge methods).
No human evaluation was conducted - the paper uses corpus-based evaluation of existing human-produced referring expressions.

overall_notes: The paper evaluates classic REG algorithms (Full Brevity, Greedy, Incremental) on referring expression generation using DICE and PRP metrics. It compares performance across languages (English, Chinese, German, Dutch) using MTUNA, ETUNA, and DTUNA datasets. The extraction was mostly accurate but needed normalization of model names and metric variants.
